status: FROZEN — thresholds declared before the first probe run; do not edit after results exist
hypothesis: SPARSE_TAG_NO_FLAG_POINTS = +100 creates a defensive tag-farming attractor. A routine tag pays exactly what a flag capture pays (+100) while being far more frequent and far less risky, and pays DOUBLE what tagging the enemy flag carrier pays (+50). If tags stop paying, the passive attractor should disappear.
status_of_hypothesis: LEADING SUSPECT, NOT PROVEN. Evidence is trajectory-based: collapsed seeds drove reward_sparse strongly up while success fell; the competent seed stayed negative on sparse and won. Causality is what this probe tests.

design.control_reference: existing G0-v2 baseline seeds 2500001/2/3 (SPARSE_TAG_NO_FLAG_POINTS = +100) — reused, not retrained
design.symmetry_note: the constant is applied to BOTH directions (+ blue tags opponent, - blue is tagged). Zeroing removes both. Zeroing only the income would leave attack punished with no compensating income and could make camping MORE attractive, which would not be a clean test.

restored_to_baseline.reason: the previous probe zeroed this; it must return to baseline so only ONE factor differs

unchanged: map, ruleset, opponents, horizon, domain randomization

competence_definition.measured_on: held-out TASK_HEALTH panel, seeds 9300000-9300002, opponents OP6/OP9/OP12

hypothesis_specific_gate.requirement: reward_sparse must NOT increase while task performance collapses
hypothesis_specific_gate.test: sparse_up_while_task_down == false for every probe seed
hypothesis_specific_gate.note: the previous probe failed exactly this check with the failed-action penalty at zero

outcome_interpretation.collapse_disappears: tag reward is causally implicated. THEN derive a small positive value from event frequency — do not keep zero by default and do not hand-pick.
outcome_interpretation.collapse_remains: tag reward alone is not sufficient. Return to the reward decomposition and rank the next term BY DELTA, not by magnitude.
outcome_interpretation.reckless_play: some tag cost/reward is useful but +100 is oversized; sweep magnitude.
outcome_interpretation.forbidden: reading a partial result and then editing these thresholds

scale_derivation_principle_for_later: Expected CUMULATIVE tag shaping per episode should be a small fraction (10-20%) of the reward for accomplishing the objective. At the competent seed's observed ~8.4 tags per capture event, a 10% budget implies single-digit points, not 100. Not authorized until this probe resolves.
unlock_condition: at least two independent G0 seeds remain competent under a reward configuration that no longer incentivizes camping
